channel.title: Rwanda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Rwanda, every source cited.

item.title: Rwanda secures $4.97M for climate adaptation
item.description: The funds will support smallholder farmers in Gatsibo, Nyagatare, and Kayonza districts with climate-smart technologies.

item.title: Three bodies recovered from disused Ruhango mine
item.description: Rwanda Investigation Bureau probes deaths after men entered abandoned Big Mining shaft without authorisation.

item.title: Rwanda seeks solar energy partnerships in India
item.description: A Rwandan delegation is in New Delhi for the International Solar Alliance assembly to attract investment and expertise.

item.title: Rwanda hosts climate talks marking Kigali Amendment anniversary
item.description: Experts and officials gather in Kigali to assess progress and plan future actions for ozone protection and greenhouse gas reduction.

item.title: Kagame to attend Francophonie summit for top job election
item.description: Rwanda's candidate Louise Mushikiwabo seeks a third term as OIF Secretary-General against DRC's Juliana Lumumba.
